definition: Satya Narayana Nadella (born 19 August 1967) is an Indian-American business executive.
details: Strategic OpenAI partnership and Copilot rollout. He is the chairman and chief executive officer (CEO) of Microsoft, succeeding Steve Ballmer in 2014 as CEO and John W. Thompson in 2021 as chairman. Before becoming CEO, he was the executive vice president of Microsoft's cloud and enterprise group, responsible for building and running the company's computing platforms.

explainer.lead: Satya Nadella is an Indian-American business executive (born 1967). His work spans management, software industry and electrical engineering.

timeline.what: Receives the CNN-News18 Indian of the Year
